title: Personalized news intelligence and decision support

facts: Synthetic regression fixture; not a saved job or delivered client system.

story.title: Sample supplier sunsets its old export API

cover.title: Know what deserves
cover.caption: I've already put this workflow together for you. Let me walk you through how it works.

previewSteps.title: Decide
previewSteps.detail: Review the evidence and next step.

cover.footer: Illustrative sample · fictional sources, developments and counts.
cover.beat: Your post calls for more than article summaries. I would start with the decisions you want to support, then rank the developments against those priorities.

scenes.title: From your priorities to a briefing
scenes.caption: Your objectives control what gets collected, grouped and ranked.
scenes.beat: Point to the high-priority API continuity topic. The scheduled collector keeps source links and timestamps, groups the repeated notice, and sends three developments to the briefing. A failed feed is tracked separately.
details: Add or remove sources, adjust topic weights and choose report frequency through configuration.
Semantic topic matching checks meaning beyond exact keywords. Relevance ranking combines objective fit, urgency, source support and novelty.
Store canonical URLs, retrieved text and timestamps; group by canonical URL, content fingerprint and semantic event similarity.

nodes.label: Group and rank

nodes.label: Publish for review

scenes.title: What matters this morning
scenes.caption: The briefing separates an immediate check, an opportunity and a watch item.
scenes.beat: Read the three ranked cards. The API notice comes first because the sample priority is continuity. The opportunity has a bounded investigation step. The unsupported competitor claim stays on watch.
details: Rank reflects this sample objective, not universal importance.
Source confidence and business-impact confidence are separate.
The report keeps the source IDs for drill-down and never turns an unverified anecdote into a confirmed fact.

scenes.title: Why this item earns an action
scenes.caption: {{story.id}} · {{story.title}}
scenes.beat: Point to the two source excerpts and the single grouped development. The notice supports checking your dependency. It does not establish that your business is affected. Your team can approve the check, defer it, or request more evidence.
details: A repost is not independent corroboration. Keep it attached to the same story and retain the primary-source attribution.
A recommendation must identify what is supported, what is inferred and what still needs checking.

sourceFields.label: Grouping
sourceFields.value: Same supplier, API version and retirement event. B links back to A; it adds no independent confirmation.

fields.label: Recommended action
fields.value: Inventory export jobs that use this supplier. If v1 is present, confirm the migration path and test one export.

fields.label: Why / expected benefit
fields.value: The sample objective is data continuity. Finding a dependency early allows time to assess the replacement.

fields.label: Urgency
fields.value: Check this week. Migration urgency depends on actual usage and the confirmed deadline.

fields.label: Confidence
fields.value: Notice: high within the fixture. Business impact: provisional until your team checks actual API usage.

fields.label: Human decision
fields.value: Awaiting {{report.owner}}: approve the inventory check, defer, or request evidence.

content.notice: Source URLs are mock fixture references. Production reports retain genuine canonical links and supporting excerpts.

scenes.title: Know when the briefing is incomplete
scenes.caption: Collection health, report history and relevance feedback remain attached to the report.
scenes.beat: Feed F did not respond. Show the retry and the partial-coverage label on INT-014. The feedback changes the next profile version and keeps the original report intact.
details: Retry transient failures with a bounded policy; alert your team when retries are exhausted.
Persist source status, collection errors, analysis failures and report versions for investigation.
Use labeled feedback to tune relevance weights and evaluate the next version against a held-out review set.

metrics.name: Relevant priorities
metrics.definition: Share of top-ranked developments that your team labels relevant to an agreed objective. Keep a labeled holdout set to check changes.

metrics.name: Evidence coverage
